description.en:
Transaction log
This mod adds a transaction log to the game, allowing you to keep track of all your financial transactions in a single place. It includes features such as: - Transaction Logging: Automatically tracks all financial transactions (income and expenses) - Transaction combining: Groups frequent small transactions (landscaping, fuel purchase etc) to reduce log clutter. - GUI Interface: View transaction history in an in-game dialog - Transaction Details: Display ingame date/time, transaction type, amount, and current balance - Add Comments: Edit and add custom comments to individual transactions - Persistent Storage: Automatically save and load transaction data with your savegame - Export to CSV: Export transaction history to CSV files in the mod settings directory for external analysis - Clear Transaction Log: Remove all stored transactions with confirmation dialog
Default keybinding is Right Shift + T.
Source code and issue tracker at https://github.com/rittermod/FS25_TransactionLog
Changelog 2.0.0.0-dev.3: - Fixed: the transaction log window (Right Shift + T) and comment input no longer fail to open when the mod loads before other Ritter mods. - Changed: Internal groundwork for transaction enrichment - buying field inputs (fuel, seed, fertilizer, water, lime) at a buying station now records which input was bought as the transaction's subject. Captured behind the scenes; not shown in the log yet, so no visible change for players. - Changed: Internal groundwork for transaction enrichment - when a production sells its outputs directly (e.g. a bakery selling bread), each sale now records which output was sold and which production it came from. Captured behind the scenes; not shown in the log yet, so no visible change for players. - Changed: Internal groundwork for transaction enrichment - sales at a selling point now record which fill type was sold (e.g. Barley) as the transaction's subject. Captured behind the scenes; not shown in the log yet, so no visible change for players. - Changed: Internal groundwork for transaction enrichment - sales at a selling point now also record where they happened (the selling station's name) alongside the fill type. Captured behind the scenes; not shown in the log yet, so no visible change for players. - Changed: Internal groundwork for transaction enrichment - buying or selling animals at the animal dealer now records which animal was traded (e.g. a Holstein cow) as the transaction's subject. Captured behind the scenes; not shown in the log yet, so no visible change for players. - Changed: Internal groundwork for transaction enrichment - buying or selling a vehicle, tool, or placeable now records which item it was (e.g. a specific tractor or barn) as the transaction's subject. Captured behind the scenes; not shown in the log yet, so no visible change for players. - Changed: Internal groundwork for transaction enrichment - locked in the shape a transaction's subject (what) will use: a display name, a kind (fill type, animal, or store item), and a best-effort id. This widens the earlier fill-type-only groundwork so future detail can also cover bought/sold vehicles, tools, and placeables. Not populated yet; no change for players. - Changed: Internal groundwork for transaction enrichment - batching now keeps transactions with a different subject (what) or location (where) in separate groups instead of merging them, and the concurrent-batch limit was raised (50 to 512) so the finer grouping cannot force a group to flush early. Not active yet; no change for players. - Changed: Internal groundwork for transaction enrichment - reworked how a transaction's fields are passed at capture (named fields instead of positional order) to prevent mix-ups as more detail is added. No change for players. - Internal groundwork for transaction enrichment - added the mechanism that will attach a transaction's subject (what) and location (where) at capture. Not active yet; no change for players. - Changed: Internal groundwork for upcoming transaction detail - the save file and network layer can now carry what a transaction was about (fill type / animal) and where it happened (placeable). Not populated yet; no change in singleplayer.
Changelog 2.0.0.0-dev.2: - Multiplayer: players now see and export only their own farm's transaction log (view and export isolation). - Server: automatic CSV exports are now split per farm - one file per farm each day/month/year, so no auto-export file mixes different farms' transactions. - Multiplayer: only an admin can clear the transaction log now, and clearing wipes it for every player (handled on the server). - Multiplayer: only a farm admin can change mod settings now; the change is saved on the server and applied to every player's settings menu. - Multiplayer: farm managers can now add and edit transaction comments, and the change syncs to everyone on that farm. - Multiplayer: Add Comment and Export are now shown only to farm managers (workers no longer see them). - Added: Players not in a farm now see a "join a farm" hint in the log instead of an empty table. - Fixed: mod settings are now saved to the correct folder; a misnamed settings file left by an earlier version is moved there automatically when you load, with no settings lost.
Changelog 2.0.0.0-dev.1: - Breaking change: Transaction logs from earlier versions are not carried over - the storage format changed for the 2.0 line. - Improved: Transaction types and categories now display in your current game language, instead of the language they were recorded in. - Changed: On first load after updating, your existing log is automatically exported to CSV and a fresh log is started (an on-screen message names the exported file). - Changed: Each transaction now carries a stable internal id, so saved and exported logs keep their original capture order regardless of how the viewer is sorted (groundwork for multiplayer). - Changed: Internal groundwork for multiplayer - balance capture, save/load, and settings persistence now run only on the game host/server. No change in singleplayer. - Changed: Internal groundwork for multiplayer - added the network event layer that will carry transactions between host and clients. Not active yet; no change in singleplayer. - Changed: Internal groundwork for multiplayer - the host now records every farm's transactions and delivers each new entry only to the farm it belongs to. Not active yet; no change in singleplayer. - Changed: Internal groundwork for multiplayer - players joining or switching farms now receive a snapshot of their farm's transaction history, so each player's log matches their own farm. Not active yet; no change in singleplayer.
Changelog 1.1.0.1: - Removed leftover debug loglevel setting to clean up log output.
Changelog 1.1.0.0: - Transaction Log now supports automatic CSV export on daily, monthly, or yearly intervals configurable in the in-game settings menu. Auto-exports are saved with timestamped filenames (e.g., "auto_20241209" for daily) and include transactions from the time period.
